summary: Comprehensive, production-grade architectural blueprint and implementation plan for Numo. Details the universal Expo Router mobile and web client scaffolded inside apps/mobile, Hono/Next.js serverless tRPC backend, Neon Postgres with Drizzle ORM double-entry ledger, Clerk authentication with biometric fallback, ImageKit.io media pipeline, Sentry observability, CodeRabbit CI/CD, the 8-step onboarding flow, screen-by-screen breakdown, 8 accounting rules, and all 10 acceptance scenarios.
